Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including detailed building sizes, ages, and specialized spaces; robust condition assessment covering all major systems with Facility Condition Index data and lifecycle planning; connects condition data to long-term capital planning (Facility Condition Assessments, pages 103-119).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Detailed enrollment projections with methodology, demographic analysis, and attendance area impacts; capacity analysis includes state standards, classroom utilization, and impacts of Transitional Kindergarten and Extended Learning Programs; clear connection of enrollment trends to facility needs and space utilization (Enrollment, Capacity, and Utilization Analysis, pages 91-102).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational goals and district mission are clearly integrated with facilities planning; detailed discussion of educational specifications including support for TK, CTE, special education, project-based learning, and technology-rich environments; facility projects directly respond to educational needs (District and Community Profile, pages 32-41; Community Engagement Summary, pages 53-90).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: District-wide data and analysis on outdoor spaces including resilient schoolyard concepts, green schoolyards, shade structures, permeable surfaces, and stormwater management; detailed site master plans include greening strategies and outdoor learning spaces; greening framed as climate resilience strategy (Climate Readiness and Site Master Plans, pages 45-52, 121-198).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Climate readiness is a central theme throughout the plan; comprehensive climate risk assessment addressing multiple impacts; detailed strategies for mitigation including HVAC upgrades, building envelope improvements, stormwater management, and energy resilience; climate readiness integrated into long-range planning and site projects (Climate Readiness, pages 45-52).

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Energy resilience and efficiency are core components of the plan; includes baseline energy data, strategies for electrification, renewable energy integration, and microgrids; references state requirements such as Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals; detailed phased retrofit and new construction plans to reduce emissions and improve resilience (Climate Readiness and Site Master Plans, pages 45-52, 121-198).

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Comprehensive capital strategy with detailed cost estimates by project and phase, including escalation and contingencies; clear prioritization framework aligned with safety, equity, educational goals, and climate resilience; multiple funding sources identified including bonds, state programs, developer fees, and alternative financing; long-term financial sustainability considered (Financial Summary & Implementation, pages 199-208).
